settings.heading: Liber Music Player
settings.musicFolder.name: Music folder
settings.musicFolder.desc: Folder containing audio files (relative to vault root; leave empty to scan the entire vault).
settings.musicFolder.placeholder: Enter or choose a folder path
settings.autoPlay.name: Autoplay when opened
settings.autoPlay.desc: When enabled, the player starts automatically on open. Pick a track with the search field below, or leave it empty for the first track in All.
settings.autoPlayTrack.name: Autoplay track
settings.autoPlayTrack.desc: Type to search and pick a track; leave empty to use the first track in the All list (current sort order).
settings.keepScreenAwake.name: Keep screen awake
settings.keepScreenAwake.desc: Prevents screen from sleeping while audio is playing (useful for viewing lyrics and turntable on phones and tablets).
settings.dailyNotesScrobbler.name: Record to Daily Notes
settings.dailyNotesScrobbler.desc: Automatically appends finished tracks to your daily note journal.
settings.dailyNotesHeading.name: Daily Notes heading
settings.dailyNotesHeading.desc: Section heading under which tracks will be scrobbled (default: ## 🎧 Music Log).
settings.crossfadeDuration.name: Crossfade duration
settings.crossfadeDuration.desc: Duration in seconds of smooth crossfading between tracks (0 = bit-transparent strict gapless pre-buffering).
settings.replayGainMode.name: ReplayGain volume normalization
settings.replayGainMode.desc: Normalizes acoustic loudness across tracks using embedded ReplayGain / R128 tags.
settings.replayGainMode.album: Album Gain (preserves dynamics across an album)
settings.eqEnabled.name: 10-band equalizer
settings.eqEnabled.desc: Enable the 10-band graphic/parametric equalizer DSP engine.
settings.eqPreset.name: Equalizer preset
settings.turntableStyle.name: Turntable faceplate style
settings.turntableStyle.desc: Skeuomorphic material styling: Brushed Obsidian, Vintage Walnut, or Cyberpunk Acrylic.
settings.dynamicAlbumTheme.name: Dynamic album art theming
settings.dynamicAlbumTheme.desc: Extracts vibrant accent palettes from active album artwork to dynamically style the player.
settings.showVisualizer.name: Audio spectrum visualizer
settings.showVisualizer.desc: Renders real-time reactive audio frequency bars during playback.
settings.syncFolderPlaylists.name: Folder-to-playlist auto-sync
settings.syncFolderPlaylists.desc: Automatically mirror music folders in the vault as dedicated playlists.
settings.folderPlaylistDepth.name: Folder playlist scan depth
settings.folderPlaylistDepth.desc: Depth of directory hierarchy to index as separate folder playlists (default: 1).
settings.enableWasmVorbisDecoder.name: WebAssembly Vorbis codec (iOS/iPadOS parity)
settings.enableWasmVorbisDecoder.desc: Decodes OGG/OPUS audio via inlined WebAssembly on platforms where native WebKit playback is unsupported.

rebuild.title: Rebuild library data
rebuild.body:
This will fully rebuild your music library:

1. Rescan all audio files
2. Re-extract metadata (title, artist, album, lyrics)
3. Regenerate artist and album categories
4. Remove invalid entries from favorites and playlists
5. Overwrite the plugin data file

Depending on library size, this may take from tens of seconds to several minutes. The player may feel slow or briefly unresponsive; your audio files will not be modified.

Rebuild now?
